name: misleading-stacktrace-workflow
description: Workflow-enforced version of misleading-stacktrace. The stacktrace points to userService.js but the real bug is in auth.js. Phase 1 forces full investigation (reading all files in the error path, tracing data flow) before any edits. Phase 2 implements the fix in the correct file. Tests whether workflow separation prevents the common failure of patching the symptom location instead of the root cause.
